title: Global Health & Vital Statistics
blurb: Aggregated indicators, burden-of-disease estimates, mortality and cancer statistics for countries and regions worldwide.

items.name: WHO Global Health Observatory
items.description: WHO's portal of 1,000+ health indicators for 194 member states — mortality, disease burden, health systems, SDG targets — with an OData API.
items.access_note: Open web, CSV and API access.

items.name: GBD Results (IHME)
items.description: Estimates of deaths, DALYs, prevalence and risk-factor burden for 370+ diseases and injuries in 204 countries from 1990 onward.
items.provider: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation
items.access_note: Free for non-commercial use; login required for bulk downloads.

paper.label: GBD 2021 Diseases and Injuries Collaborators. Lancet 2024;403:2133

items.name: Global Health Data Exchange (GHDx)
items.description: IHME's searchable catalogue of the world's surveys, censuses, vital registration and disease registries, linking to source data wherever available.
items.provider: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation
items.access_note: Open catalogue; access terms of each linked dataset vary.

items.name: World Bank Health, Nutrition & Population Statistics
items.description: Country-level time series on health financing, service coverage, nutrition, population dynamics and outcomes, downloadable via DataBank or API.

items.name: Our World in Data
items.description: Curated, well-documented global datasets and charts on health topics (causes of death, vaccination, COVID-19, child mortality, life expectancy) with GitHub-hosted data.
items.provider: Global Change Data Lab / University of Oxford

paper.label: Mathieu E et al. Nat Hum Behav 2021;5:947

items.name: WHO Mortality Database
items.description: Deaths by country, year, sex, age and ICD cause as reported by national civil-registration systems since 1950.
items.access_note: Open web tool and raw-file download.

items.name: Human Mortality Database
items.description: High-quality, harmonised life tables, death counts and population exposures for ~40 countries, the reference source for demographic mortality research.
items.provider: UC Berkeley / Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research

items.name: Global Cancer Observatory (GLOBOCAN)
items.description: IARC's estimates of cancer incidence, mortality and prevalence for 185 countries, plus Cancer Over Time, Cancer Tomorrow and Cancer Survival modules.
items.provider: International Agency for Research on Cancer

paper.label: Bray F et al. CA Cancer J Clin 2024;74:229

items.name: CDC WONDER
items.description: Online query system for US public-health data: births, deaths (multiple cause), cancer statistics, vaccine adverse events, environmental and population data.
items.provider: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
items.access_note: Open web queries; agree to data-use restrictions on each query.

items.name: NCHS Vital Statistics Online
items.description: Public-use micro-data files for every US birth, death and fetal death record, released annually by NCHS.
items.provider: CDC National Center for Health Statistics

items.name: CDC PLACES
items.description: Model-based small-area estimates of 40 chronic-disease measures for US counties, cities, census tracts and ZIP codes.
items.provider: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

items.name: UNAIDS AIDSinfo
items.description: Country-level HIV estimates — prevalence, incidence, AIDS deaths, treatment cascade and key populations — from UNAIDS modelling.

items.name: Eurostat Health Statistics
items.description: EU-wide statistics on causes of death, health-care resources and expenditure, health status (EHIS) and accidents at work.

items.name: HealthData.gov
items.description: US federal catalogue of thousands of health datasets from HHS agencies (CDC, CMS, FDA, NIH) with API access.
items.provider: US Department of Health & Human Services

items.name: CMS Data (data.cms.gov)
items.description: Public Medicare and Medicaid datasets: provider utilisation and payments, Part D prescribers, hospital quality and cost reports.

items.name: DATASUS (TabNet)
items.description: Brazilian Ministry of Health information system: hospital admissions (SIH), mortality (SIM), births (SINASC), notifiable diseases (SINAN) and more.
items.access_note: Open web tabulation and file downloads.

items.name: WorldPop
items.description: High-resolution gridded population, demographic, births and urbanisation estimates for every country — essential denominators for health mapping.
